title: 사라진 열쇠의 시계탑 호텔
description: 폭풍이 지나간 밤, 여우 탐정과 토끼 조수가 시계탑 호텔 로비에서 사라진 황금 열쇠의 단서를 찾아보세요.
theme: 동물 탐정단의 사라진 황금 열쇠 시계탑 호텔 사건
scene: A grand whimsical 1930s clocktower hotel lobby on a calm night just after a rainstorm, viewed straight-on from a comfortable medium-wide angle. Warm amber wall lamps mix with cool moonlight through tall rain-speckled windows. At the lower-left, the recurring friendly fox detective wears the same burgundy trench coat and holds one large closed midnight-blue umbrella with one clearly visible coral-red curved handle. Near the fox, the recurring friendly rabbit assistant wears the same teal beret and carries a blank evidence notebook. At center, a polished dark-wood reception desk displays one oversized antique-gold hotel key with a clearly visible five-point star-shaped bow, resting alone on a cream cloth. Behind the desk, one tall ornate grandfather clock has one large clearly visible round antique-gold pendulum disk. At the upper-right, a friendly brown bear bellhop in a deep-teal uniform and pillbox cap stands beside a brass luggage cart; exactly one large gold round button is centered on the front of the cap. At the lower-right, exactly three large vintage suitcases are stacked separately on the luggage cart: burgundy, cream, and muted jade. At the upper-left, one large chandelier hangs with exactly four clearly separated warm amber glass shades. Add a patterned rug without symbols, potted palm, brass handbell, plain envelopes without writing, wall molding, and soft marble-floor reflections only as supporting atmosphere. Keep the umbrella handle, star-shaped key bow, pendulum disk, bellhop cap button, three suitcases, and four chandelier shades large, unobstructed, spatially separated, and away from the outer 3% safe margin. No readable signs, labels, letters, numbers, or clock numerals.
